description: Global functions exposed directly on the `lje` table.

functions.name: include
functions.description: Loads a script file relative to the current script's directory. Optionally controls whether the script is executed immediately after loading. Defaults to executing if the second argument is omitted. Requires an active script context. Load and runtime errors are printed to the console rather than raised, in which case nothing is returned.

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the script file, relative to the current script.

params.name: execute
params.description: Whether to execute the script after loading. Defaults to `true`.

returns.description: If `execute` is `false`, the loaded function. Otherwise, everything the executed script returned. Nothing is returned on failure.

functions.name: con_print
functions.description: Prints a message to the console, prefixed with `[LJE CONSOLE]`.
